mapper.select: SELECT account_id, person_id, username, password_hash, status, failed_login_attempts, locked_until, token_version, last_login_at FROM app_account WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT account_id, person_id, username, password_hash, status, failed_login_attempts, locked_until, token_version, last_login_at FROM app_account WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
SELECT r.role_code FROM account_global_role ar JOIN app_role r ON r.role_id = ar.role_id WHERE ar.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY r.role_code
SELECT role_id FROM app_role WHERE role_code = #{roleCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_account (username, password_hash, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, 'ACTIVE')
INSERT IGNORE INTO account_global_role (account_id, role_id) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{roleId})
mapper.update: UPDATE app_account SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, status = 'ACTIVE', failed_login_attempts = 0, locked_until = NULL, token_version = token_version + 1 WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
UPDATE app_account SET failed_login_attempts = 0, locked_until = NULL, status = 'ACTIVE', last_login_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE account_id = #{accountId}

UPDATE app_account SET failed_login_attempts = 0, locked_until = NULL, status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'LOCKED' AND locked_until IS NOT NULL AND locked_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_token_session (account_id, token_hash, expires_at, user_agent) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{userAgent})
mapper.select: SELECT refresh_token_session_id, account_id, token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at FROM refresh_token_session WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} FOR UPDATE
